title: P0.22: Consultation State Machine + Resource Pressure Deferral + Permission Reply Disambiguation
description: Two critical bugs in the external consultation flow: (1) _try_resolve_pending_observation_permission() incorrectly interprets 'si' as observation permission when the block was resource_pressure, not a permission issue. (2) sendChat() closes the local interaction before the external worker finishes, leaving dispatch_terminal with empty interaction_id.
reason: resource_pressure blocks were indistinguishable from observation_permission blocks in _pending_observation_permission_assistant(). The method returned assistant_kind from any external_consultation_preflight, regardless of block type. Combined with overly broad affirmative keyword matching, this caused status questions like 'si puedes hacer la consulta si o no?' to be misinterpreted as permission grants.
next_action: Validate live ChatGPT consultation after resource pressure is normal. Run IABV on Windows, trigger external consultation, verify: (1) resource_pressure block shows deferred message, (2) status questions are not intercepted as permission grants, (3) interaction_id is preserved through dispatch lifecycle.
resume_hint: P0.22 code fix applied: _pending_observation_permission_assistant() now checks phase_key=='observation_permission', _try_resolve_pending_observation_permission() rejects status questions and requires explicit permission phrases, sendChat() preserves interaction when external worker is alive, _blocked_external_consultation_result() maps resource_pressure to blocked_by_resource_pressure terminal_state.

metadata.root_cause: Bug 1: _pending_observation_permission_assistant() returned assistant_kind from generic preflight metadata without checking phase_key, so resource_pressure blocks were treated as pending observation permission. Bug 2: sendChat() called _resolve_active_interaction(outcome='resolved', provider='local') immediately after _try_resolve_pending_observation_permission() returned True, even though _grant_pending_observation_permission() had already spawned an external worker via _run_external_consultation().

evidence.event: dispatch_started external_consultation chatgpt, blocked by resource_pressure, terminal_state=failed_with_actionable_reason
permission misclassification caused spurious retry, dispatch_terminal had empty interaction_id
evidence.bug: status question 'si puedes hacer la consulta si o no?' intercepted as observation permission grant

fixes_applied.task_b: _try_resolve_pending_observation_permission() rejects _is_operational_status_question(), requires explicit permission phrases or last_guidance=='approve_observation_permission' for short affirmatives
fixes_applied.task_c: sendChat() uses outcome='awaiting_external_response' when _working is True after permission grant, preserving interaction_id
fixes_applied.task_d: _blocked_external_consultation_result() detects resource_pressure via _is_resource_pressure_block() and sets terminal_state='blocked_by_resource_pressure' with explicit deferred user message
